blocks.alt: Laal kinare wale nau diamond pictograms, simple kaale symbols ke saath: explosive (phat-ta bomb), flammable (shola), oxidising (circle par shola), compressed gas (gas cylinder), corrosive (tubes se surface aur haath par tapakta liquid), toxic (khopri aur haddiyan), irritant ya harmful (exclamation mark), environment ke liye harmful (sookha darakht aur machhli) aur health hazard (insaan jis ke seene par star jaisa nishan).
blocks.caption: Figure 16.2: Chemical hazards ke pictograms (kitab ki Figure 16.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har pictogram ek laal kinare wala diamond hai jis ke andar ek nishan hai. Chemical ki botal ke label par yeh nishan dekh kar foran pata chal jata hai ke woh phat sakta hai (explosive), aag pakarta hai (flammable), jalata hai (corrosive), zehreela hai (toxic) waghera.
Lab mein kaam karne wala chemicals ko standard procedures ke mutabiq istemal kare, aur har chemical ke khaas khatre aur us ke safe istemal ke liye zaroori precautions (ehtiyat) ko saamne rakhe.

blocks.caption: Practice mein chemical hazards
rows: Har chemical ke liye standard procedure par chalein
Shuru karne se pehle hazards pehchanein
Kabhi koi compound ya gas chakhein ya soonghein nahi

blocks.prompt: Koi reagent pehli baar istemal karne se pehle student us ke khatre kahan se maloom kare?
blocks.explanation: Us chemical ke standard procedure se aur botal ke label par lage hazard pictograms (Figure 16.2) se; kaam shuru karne se pehle yeh khatre aur zaroori precautions jaan lein.

items: Chemical hazards: har chemical ko standard procedure se istemal karein, us ke hazards aur precautions jaan kar.
Label par hazard pictograms (Figure 16.2) khatre ki type batate hain.
